text: FIX a replication `pull.modifier` or `push.modifier` that throws now cancels the replication instead of going on without the failed batch, so that no document is skipped. The error is emitted once on `error$` as `RC_PULL` or `RC_PUSH`, nothing of the failed batch is written or sent and no checkpoint is stored for it. Calling `replicateRxCollection()` again with the same `replicationIdentifier` and a fixed modifier continues from the last checkpoint and replicates the documents of the failed batch. This follows the previous change of the modifier error handling
